name: Threshold Watch
office_task: Every Monday, check job margin, debtors and cash, and when one has moved past the line we set since last week, tell the person we named, with both weeks' figures and where they came from.
systems_of_record: the job system (Simpro, ServiceM8 and the like): gross margin on jobs completed in the week, read only
the ledger (Xero or MYOB): debtors outstanding, debtors over sixty days and the reconciled bank balance, read only
the system the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the week's key numbers per audience (owner, external accountant), each figure carrying its definition id, source and as-of time, or published as unavailable with the reason; a correction is a new version superseding the old, with the named person and the reason
emits.readback: reading the period's reports back returns each report_id with its version, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and report.publish_failed is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a source that could not be read, a measure with no definition or two, a threshold that could not be compared because a week's figure is unavailable, a correction missing a person or reason, or a view that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the period, the measure, the reason and the exception_owner
